page_content: Enterprise Leave Policy Employees are entitled to 12 casual leaves per calendar year. Casual leave must be requested through the HR portal at least one working day in advance except during emergencies. Employees are entitled to 15 earned leaves per calendar year. Earned leave requests of more than five consecutive working days require manager approval and HR acknowledgement. Employees are entitled to 10 sick leaves per calendar year. Sick leave longer than two consecutive working days requires a medical certificate. Unused casual leave does not carry forward to the next year. Unused earned leave can be carried forward up to a maximum balance of 30 days.

Enterprise Security Guidelines Employees must use multi-factor authentication for email, VPN, cloud applications, and administrative systems. MFA must not be disabled without written approval from the Information Security team. Confidential documents must not be shared through personal email, public file-sharing links, or unmanaged messaging applications. Approved channels include the enterprise document portal and encrypted corporate email. Any suspected phishing email must be reported using the phishing report button in the mail client. Employees should not click links, download attachments, or reply to suspicious messages. USB storage devices are restricted by default. Temporary USB access requires manager approval, business justification, and endpoint security review. Security incidents must be reported within 30 minutes of discovery. n, and endpoint security review. Security incidents must be reported within 30 minutes of discovery. Examples include lost devices, unauthorized access, malware alerts, credential exposure, and accidental data disclosure.

Project Documentation Standard Every enterprise project must maintain a project charter, scope statement, stakeholder list, architecture notes, risk register, and delivery plan. Project status reports must be submitted every Friday before 5:00 PM. The report should include completed work, upcoming milestones, blockers, risks, decisions required, and dependency updates. Technical documentation must include system overview, architecture diagram, API contracts, deployment steps, environment variables, monitoring setup, and rollback procedure. Change requests must be reviewed by the project manager and approved by the change advisory board when the change affects timeline, cost, security, or production stability. At project closure, the team must submit final documentation, lessons learned, support handover notes, access inventory, and production readiness confirmation.

IT Support SOP All IT support requests must be submitted through the Service Desk portal. Employees should include the asset tag, operating system, error screenshot, business impact, and contact number. Priority 1 incidents include complete network outages, production system downtime, security lockouts affecting multiple users, and data loss events. Priority 1 incidents must be acknowledged within 15 minutes and escalated to the IT Operations Manager. Password reset requests are treated as standard service requests. The helpdesk must verify the employee identity using the registered mobile number or manager approval before resetting credentials. Laptops issued to employees must have endpoint protection, disk encryption, VPN configuration, and approved productivity software installed before handover. Resolved tickets must include root cause, action taken, resolution time, and preventive r
nd approved productivity software installed before handover. Resolved tickets must include root cause, action taken, resolution time, and preventive recommendation before closure.

Employee Handbook Employees are expected to follow the organization code of conduct, protect company information, and maintain respectful communication with colleagues, customers, and partners. Standard working hours are 9:30 AM to 6:30 PM, Monday through Friday. Flexible work arrangements may be approved by the reporting manager based on project requirements and business continuity needs. Employees must complete mandatory onboarding training within 15 days of joining. Mandatory modules include information security awareness, HR policies, workplace ethics, and data privacy. Performance reviews are conducted twice per year. Employees and managers should document goals, achievements, skill development areas, and feedback before the review discussion. Business travel expenses must be submitted within 10 working days after travel completion with valid invoices and manager approval.

Enterprise Security Guidelines V1 Enterprise Security Guidelines V1 Department: Security Document Type: Policy Access Level: restricted Version: 1.0 Purpose This document defines operational guidance for the Security department. It is written for employees, managers, auditors, and support teams who need clear enterprise procedures. Policy Details Multi-factor authentication is mandatory for email, VPN, and cloud systems.
